_about: Sandstorms over the open desert. Regions are region numbers (RGNxx's hex): the rocky wastes 2, 4, 5, the red desert 7, 8, the pale flats 9, 10, 18, 20, the sand sea 33, 34, 35. A storm blows once in each EveryHours of game time, at a time each region and period pick, ShortestMinutes to LongestMinutes long. Sight is in squares; Volume is of the sound effects' loudness.
